clips.title: Dubai Skyline
clips.prompt: Breathtaking paper-cut diorama of Dubai. Every element handcrafted from layered colored cardstock with crisp folded edges, intricate cut-out details, and realistic paper textures: the Burj Khalifa rising in stacked paper tiers, sail-shaped towers, palm fronds and marina boats below. Warm sunlight casts soft paper shadows that slowly sweep across the layers as paper clouds drift between the towers and tiny paper cars glide along a curved road. Ultra detailed papercraft, vibrant colors, cinematic composition, museum-quality paper sculpture, highly intricate layered cardstock art, clean precision cuts, depth-rich 3D paper scene. Slow lateral dolly across the skyline with gentle parallax between paper layers, shallow depth of field, ultra high resolution, 24fps.
